description: Enhancement-style melee weaver - weaves autoattacks and Fist of the Ancients to proc Elemental Carvings and Runic Brand detonations.
_source_note: Built from CoA handoff doc (real playstyle/rotation/ability names) + confirmed screenshot numbers where available (Runic Brand, Fist of the Ancients confirmed via screenshot). Real mechanic per handoff: Fist of the Ancients procs a random Elemental Carving (Fire=armor pen, Water=mana, Earth=HoT, Air=haste); Runic Brand stacks a magic-damage-taken mark cashed in by its detonation.

nodes.name: Primordial Strength
nodes.description: Increases spell damage scaling from Attack Power by 3% per rank.

nodes.name: Engraved and Ready
nodes.description: Increases Weapon Engraving trigger chance by 1% per rank.

nodes.name: Ley Focus
nodes.description: Increases haste and critical strike chance by 1% per rank.

nodes.name: Attuned Efficiency
nodes.description: Reduces the Mana cost of Runic Tattoos by 3% per rank and increases Runic Tattoos: Water's mana restore.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Engravement Level 15 Passive - Reduces Runic Tattoo mana cost; boosts Runic Tattoos: Water's mana restore.'

nodes.name: Elementalist
nodes.description: Increases Weapon Engraving proc damage by 4% per rank.

nodes.name: Fists of Power
nodes.description: Runeblade strikes an extra time with your off-hand weapon.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Fists of Power (Level 10 Passive) - Runeblade strikes an extra time (off-hand %).'

nodes.name: Focusing Crystals
nodes.description: Increases Magic damage by 2% per rank and grants partial in-combat mana regen.

nodes.name: Leystone Springs
nodes.description: Auto attacks have a chance to restore mana.

nodes.name: Fist of the Ancients
nodes.description: Learn Fist of the Ancients, striking your target and a nearby enemy for Elemental damage, triggering Weapon Engravings and a random Elemental Carving.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: Lvl 24, 'Smash an enemy and 1 nearby enemy with your rune-engraved fists, dealing 74 Elemental Damage and triggering your Weapon Engraving.'

nodes.name: Runic Brand
nodes.description: Learn Runic Brand, branding an enemy with a stacking magic-damage-taken mark. Runeblade detonates the mark for bonus damage.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: Lvl 18, Engravement(1), 4 Mana, melee range, instant, 12 sec cooldown, 'Requires One-Handed Melee Weapon. Brand an enemy, dealing 23 Fire damage with each weapon, and marking the enemy for 8 sec... Your next Runeblade on the enemy causes a Runic Explosion, dealing an additional 167 Spellfire Damage to nearby enemies.' The class's real Engravement generator/spender identity.

nodes.name: Elemental Carvings
nodes.description: Fist of the Ancients unleashes a random Elemental Carving: Fire grants Armor Penetration, Water restores mana, Earth heals you.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Elemental Carvings (Level 30 Passive) - Fist of the Ancients unleashes a random Elemental Carving (Fire: armor pen. Water: mana regen. Earth: % missing health restore).' This spec's core proc-reward loop.

nodes.name: Power Overwhelming
nodes.description: Runeblade and Primordial Blast have a chance to reset Runic Brand's cooldown.

nodes.name: Leyline Disturbance
nodes.description: Learn Leyline Disturbance, a party-wide melee and ranged haste aura that also reduces stun duration on you.

nodes.name: Guarding Rune
nodes.description: Learn Guarding Rune, dropping a ground zone that reduces Magic damage taken by nearby allies.

nodes.name: Zenith
nodes.description: A burst cooldown that greatly increases Weapon Engraving trigger chance for a duration.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as Engravement's burst capstone: 'Boosts Weapon Engraving trigger chance, for a duration.'

nodes.name: Runic Tempest
nodes.description: Learn Runic Tempest, resetting Fist of the Ancients' cooldown.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Runic Tempest - Resets Fist of the Ancients cooldown; enables Runeshroud-required abilities + castable while moving.'

nodes.name: Magic Etchings
nodes.description: Primordial Blast damage reduces the target's Armor by 3% per rank, stacking.

nodes.name: Runes of Quickness
nodes.description: Grants the party a spell haste buff and increases Glyphic spell range. Does not stack with similar effects.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Party/raid spell haste buff (no stacking with similar); boosts Glyphic spell range.'

nodes.name: Leyborn
nodes.description: Runic Brand's mark now stacks up to 3 times.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Marked: Runic Brand stacks 3 times.'

nodes.name: Swift Etching
nodes.description: After Hurricane ends, increases your melee attack speed and critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Steam Conjurer
nodes.description: Weapon Engraving: Earth damage has a chance to cast Wild Steam.

nodes.name: Resonance Rune
nodes.description: Learn Resonance Rune, a ground rune that dispels harmful magic from allies and purges beneficial magic from enemies in radius.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Ground rune: dispels harmful magic from allies, purges beneficial magic from enemies in radius.'

nodes.name: Rune of the Elder Magus
nodes.description: Increases Primordial Blast critical strike damage by 8% per rank.

nodes.name: Power Engraving
nodes.description: Learn Power Engraving, a ground zone that grants allies increased Magic damage and critical strike chance.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc, called out as a group DPS cooldown to save for the kill in Engravement's dungeon writeup: 'Ground zone: allies get Magic damage + crit chance boost.'

nodes.name: Rune of the Kirin Tor
nodes.description: Power Engraving also periodically restores mana to affected allies.

nodes.name: Protective Warding
nodes.description: Taking a critical hit reduces the cooldown of Guarding Rune.

nodes.name: Granite Resolve
nodes.description: Reduces Physical damage taken. Usable while stunned.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Reduces Physical damage taken. Usable while stunned.' Real on-demand physical mitigation cooldown.

nodes.name: Ley Power
nodes.description: Increases your damage per nearby enemy, up to a cap, and increases melee/spell haste while active.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc, called out as a Strength: 'Ley Power ramps damage per nearby enemy... being outnumbered is the shape this spec wants.'

nodes.name: Decoder
nodes.description: Elemental Burst and Runeblade have a chance to instantly trigger a Weapon Engraving.
